prompt: {"headline":"The pelacarsen Phase 3 Lp(a)HORIZON trial failed to meet its primary cardiovascular endpoint, consistent with an underpowered design expecting only a 12.3% relative risk reduction (HR 0.877) at 54.1% power.","summary":"The trial randomized 8,323 patients with established cardiovascular disease and Lp(a) ≥70 mg/dL to pelacarsen or placebo, targeting 993 primary endpoint events.
